desc: The Half Face Blades Extremis is a tough, reliable fixed blade knife. The unique spine jimping gives you grip without digging into your hand, while the chiseled handle provides solid control. Plus, the Kydex sheath offers a secure, low-profile carry. With full tang construction and a hollow grind, the Extremis delivers powerful, precise cuts and excels at both push and pull cuts. Perfect for EDC or tactical use.
